title: Include the recorded revision's observation time in the measured-unchanged refusal so a host can send the content comparison
outcome: Include the recorded revision's observation time in the measured-unchanged refusal so a host can send the content comparison
acceptance: The execution_observation_unrecorded_change refusal details add the observed time of the recorded revision Engram compared against (recorded_observed_at), alongside the existing workspace_id, recorded_revision and reported_revision; the existing fields and code are unchanged.

When the recorded revision's record carries an observed time, a host can build the follow-up content_comparison from the refusal details alone (test: accepted with an honest interval including the baseline). When it carries none, recorded_observed_at is null and the docs say the host cannot build the comparison from this refusal.
The host-protocol documentation for the refusal names the new field and how a host uses it.
disposal_reason: Superseded by B (w-da8c79e5d5ab), landed as master 0e52e6fd on 2026-10-31. Commit-bound Git-input eligibility replaces the sighting-based mechanism this item addressed (rules-greg-commit-clean-identity rev 5).
